WITH joined AS (
  SELECT s.transref, tr.tradekind, s.optvolrt
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON s.transref = t.transreg
  JOIN trader tr ON t.trdref = tr.tradereg
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS overall_avg FROM joined
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT transref, tradekind, AVG(optvolrt) AS pair_avg
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY transref, tradekind
),
dev AS (
  SELECT p.tradekind, p.pair_avg, ABS(p.pair_avg - o.overall_avg) AS deviation
  FROM pairs p
  CROSS JOIN overall o
),
typed AS (
  SELECT tradekind, pair_avg, deviation,
         AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY tradekind) AS type_avg_dev
  FROM dev
  WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
  SELECT tradekind, pair_avg, deviation, deviation - type_avg_dev AS excess
  FROM typed
  WHERE deviation > type_avg_dev
)
SELECT tradekind,
       AVG(pair_avg) AS avg_optvolrt,
       AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation,
       AVG(excess) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
GROUP BY tradekind;
